mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `task_dispatch_block` (task_id, checked_at, reason, pilot_candidates, drone_candidates) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{checkedAt}, #{reason}, #{pilotCandidates}, #{droneCandidates})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, checked_at, reason, pilot_candidates, drone_candidates FROM `task_dispatch_block` WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY checked_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
